page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head and page number at the top. A catchword sits at the bottom right.

main_text.p: ostendat hujus quæstionis non causam: ut lapsus sanctorum exagitentur: veram causam: 1. ne excusetur hypocrisis & simulatio. 11. ne veritas Scripturæ periclitetur.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XI.

head.i: Paraphrasis orationis Jonathæ pro Davide apud Saulem Patrem intercedentis.

main_text.p: Præmittatur ex historia occasio: de odio Saulis in Davidem: de consilio occidendi: de Jonathæ indicio: & intercessionis pollicitatione.
Argumentum I. quia est servus tuus, cui de-betur defensio.
Deducatur ex jure herili in servos, de quoPs. 123.2.Col.4.1. non inserantur ipsa dicta.
Probatio: nec in te, nec in regnum peccavit.
Maior argumenti illustretur à fine gladii regibus à Deo concessi: & amplificetur ex Thesi contraria: Grave esse, fundere sanguinem inno-xium.
Argumentum III. Quia optimè de te & regno meritus.
1. de magnitudine periculi publici & ipsius Davidis.
II. de commodis publicis victoriâ confecutis.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page appears faintly at the right edge and is left out. The decorative flourishes before "Argumentum" and "Maior" are not transcribed. The catchword "Adda-" is printed in italic script. The word "Ps." appears in the printed reference as "Ps.", transcribed with a plain s.
